scripts.dev:setup: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/state --env dev
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.eval:calibrate: node scripts/recognition-eval.mjs evaluate data/evaluation/manifest.json reports/evaluation-calibration.json calibration
scripts.eval:final: node scripts/recognition-eval.mjs evaluate data/evaluation/manifest.json reports/evaluation-final.json final reports/evaluation-calibration.json
